knowledge.markdown:
# Knowledge Base: prob-method-applications-wip-01

## Problem Understanding

The applications module ProbMethodApplications.lean stated headline probabilistic-method consequences as vacuous placeholders (every hypothesis unused; e.g. ramsey_lower_bound discharged by `le_refl`).

## Resolution

Formalized the genuine engine in Proofs/ProbMethodApplicationsWIP.lean (ProbMethod.Core), 0 sorry / 0 axiom:
- `exists_avoiding_all` (counting first moment)
- `exists_good_of_card_bound` (uniform union bound)
- `card_supersets_le` / `card_disjoint_le` / `card_mono_le`
- `ramsey_avoidance` (honest Ramsey lower bound, avoidance form)

Verified offline (LAKE_UNSAFE=1 lake env lean, EXIT 0) against Mathlib v4.26.0; PR #30657.

## Dead Ends

- Exact bijective counting of monochromatic colourings is avoidable: upper bounds via powerset injection suffice for a lower-bound existence result.

papers: Alon & Spencer, The Probabilistic Method (Wiley, 4th ed., 2016)
Erdős, Some remarks on the theory of graphs, Bull. AMS 53 (1947), 292-294
